title: SDLC Analysis Evidence Ledger
description: One entry per number a filled diagnostic deck shows, tracing it to a metric in metrics.json, the datasets it was computed from, and the records it cites. Written by the report-analyst agent next to the deck; checked by scripts/verify-report against the deck, metrics.json and the run's sidecars. Prose contract: docs/report-contract.md section 4.

run_id.description: The run directory's basename, as _run-manifest.json records it.

deck_file.description: The filled deck's filename, relative to report/.

compute_script.description: The deterministic metrics script, relative to report/.

metrics_file.description: The captured stdout of compute_script, relative to report/.

datasets_used.description: Every dataset any claim was computed from.

lower_bound_datasets.description: Exactly the truncated sidecars that appear in some claim's datasets. Copied from disk, never decided.

unavailable_datasets.description: Exactly the unavailable sidecars in the run. Copied from disk.

staleness_exclusions.description: Scope units the template's staleness filter removed before aggregation. Empty when nothing was excluded — never omitted.

unit.description: The provider-native id or name of the excluded repository, pipeline, board or service.

last_activity.description: The unit's last recorded activity as the records show it, verbatim. Absent when the records carry none.

evidence.description: Which datasets showed no activity and over what span.

disclosed_as.description: The exact text the deck's appendix uses to name this exclusion, normally the unit itself.

id.description: Stable lowercase id, dot- or dash-separated, matching the deck element's data-claim attribute.

rendered.description: The exact visible text of the deck element, whitespace collapsed.

metric.description: Dot path into metrics.json; array indices are numeric segments.

value.description: What the metric path holds. A number must be rendered faithfully; a string must appear in rendered verbatim.

population.description: The denominator or record count behind the value, when one exists.

method.description: One sentence a skeptic could re-implement from.

lower_bound.description: True exactly when any of datasets is truncated in its sidecar.

receipts.description: Provider-native ids the claim's exhibit cites; each must occur verbatim in one of the claim's records files.

diagnoses.description: One root-cause diagnosis per finding the deck presents, following docs/root-cause-method.md: the symptom, the competing hypotheses and how the records decided each, the root cause, and the remedies that act on it.

finding.description: The finding this diagnosis explains, as the deck's kicker names it (e.g. "Finding 1").

symptom.description: One sentence: what is wrong, where, and by how much.

prediction.description: What the records show if this is the cause, and what they show if it is not.

claims.description: The claims that decided the verdict. Required non-empty for supported and refuted; empty for untestable.

needs.description: For an untestable hypothesis: the dataset or evidence that would test it.

hypothesis.description: The id of the hypothesis this root cause rests on.

rendered.description: The root cause exactly as the deck states it, whitespace collapsed.

boundary.description: Where the records stop explaining, phrased as the question to ask the team.

name.description: The remedy as the deck names it. For kind anthara, the workflow name shown on the Anthara slide or sheet.

acts_on.description: root_cause: removes or prevents the cause. mechanism: catches the cause's effect at its source, before it becomes the symptom.

how.description: One sentence: how this remedy breaks the chain.
